title: UV-Box Benchtop Decontamination Chambers
meta_title: UV-Box Benchtop Decontamination Chambers | Air Science
meta_description: High-efficiency UV light chambers designed to safely decontaminate contents while providing a safe work environment. Destroy exposed surface DNA and bacteria.
meta_keywords: uv box, benchtop decontamination chamber, uv light decontamination, forensic equipment, pharmaceutical equipment, veterinary equipment, dental equipment
short_description: UV Light Box is a high-efficiency chamber designed to create light emission conditions known to safely decontaminate contents while providing for a safe work environment for the operator. High intensity UV lamps destroy exposed surface DNA and bacteria.
full_description: UV lamps are optimally placed to eliminate blind spots and corners and walls are smooth to ensure easy cleaning. Stainless steel surfaces naturally reflect UV radiation to ensure contents are fully irradiated from all directions. Professional design and construction features offer convenience and protect the safety of personnel during use, cleaning and maintenance of the cabinets. The operator is protected from UV radiation by the UV absorbing window and with safety controls to ensure that lamps cannot be activated until the cabinet door is securely closed. Other safety features include UV timer, hanging rod and shelf to support or suspend items for decontamination.
seo_content: The UV-Box Benchtop Decontamination Chambers from Air Science are designed to provide a safe and effective solution for decontaminating a variety of forensic, pharmaceutical, veterinary, and dental equipment and materials. These high-efficiency UV light chambers utilize powerful lamps to destroy exposed surface DNA and bacteria, ensuring a sterile work environment. With features like optimal UV lamp placement, smooth stainless steel construction, and comprehensive safety controls, the UV-Box line offers convenient and reliable decontamination capabilities for critical laboratory and clinical applications.
